lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: man re kiu chhootahi bin piaar ||
lines.translation: O mind, how can you be saved without love?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਖਸੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh a(n)tar rav rahiaa bakhase bhagat bha(n)daar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: God permeates the inner beings of the Gurmukhs. They are blessed with the treasure of devotion. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਨੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man aisee har siu preet kar jaisee machhulee neer ||
lines.translation: O mind, love the Lord, as the fish loves the water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਅਧਿਕਉ ਤਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu adhikau tiu sukh ghano man tan saa(n)t sareer ||
lines.translation: The more the water, the more the happiness, and the greater the peace of mind and body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਭ ਪੀਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bin jal ghaRee na jeevaee prabh jaanai abh peer ||2||
lines.translation: Without water, she cannot live, even for an instant. God knows the suffering of her mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man aisee har siu preet kar jaisee chaatrik meh ||
lines.translation: O mind, love the Lord, as the song-bird loves the rain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰ ਭਰਿ ਥਲ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਕੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: sar bhar thal hareeaavale ik boo(n)d na pavaee keh ||
lines.translation: The pools are overflowing with water, and the land is luxuriantly green, but what are they to her, if that single drop of rain does not fall into her mouth?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੇਹ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: karam milai so paaeeai kirat paiaa sir deh ||3||
lines.translation: By His Grace, she receives it; otherwise, because of her past actions, she gives her head. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਜਲ ਦੁਧ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man aisee har siu preet kar jaisee jal dudh hoi ||
lines.translation: O mind, love the Lord, as the water loves the milk.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਟਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਖਵੈ ਦੁਧ ਕਉ ਖਪਣਿ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavatan aape khavai dudh kau khapan na dei ||
lines.translation: The water, added to the milk, itself bears the heat, and prevents the milk from burning.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aape mel vichhu(n)niaa sach vadiaaee dei ||4||
lines.translation: God unites the separated ones with Himself again, and blesses them with true greatness. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man aisee har siu preet kar jaisee chakavee soor ||
lines.translation: O mind, love the Lord, as the chakvee duck loves the sun.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin pal need na sovaee jaanai door hajoor ||
lines.translation: She does not sleep, for an instant or a moment; the sun is so far away, but she thinks that it is near.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh sojhee naa pavai guramukh sadaa hajoor ||5||
lines.translation: Understanding does not come to the self-willed manmukh. But to the Gurmukh, the Lord is always close. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਵਣੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh ganat ganaavanee karataa kare s hoi ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs make their calculations and plans, but only the actions of the Creator come to pass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kee keemat naa pavai je lochai sabh koi ||
lines.translation: His Value cannot be estimated, even though everyone may wish to do so.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: guramat hoi ta paaeeai sach milai sukh hoi ||6||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, it is revealed. Meeting with the True One, peace is found. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa nehu na tutaee je satigur bhetai soi ||
lines.translation: True love shall not be broken, if the True Guru is met.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan padaarath paaeeai tribhavan sojhee hoi ||
lines.translation: Obtaining the wealth of spiritual wisdom, the understanding of the three worlds is acquired.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: niramal naam na veesarai je gun kaa gaahak hoi ||7||
lines.translation: So become a customer of merit, and do not forget the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਲਿ ਗਏ ਸੇ ਪੰਖਣੂੰ ਜੋ ਚੁਗਦੇ ਸਰ ਤਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: khel gae se pa(n)khanoo(n) jo chugade sar tal ||
lines.translation: Those birds which peck at the shore of the pool have played and have departed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘੜੀ ਕਿ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਖੇਲਣੁ ਅਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghaRee k muhat k chalanaa khelan aj k kal ||
lines.translation: In a moment, in an instant, we too must depart. Our play is only for today or tomorrow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਚਾ ਪਿੜੁ ਮਲਿ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jis too(n) melahi so milai jaai sachaa piR mal ||8||
lines.translation: But those whom You unite, Lord, are united with You; they obtain a seat in the Arena of Truth. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur preet na oopajai haumai mail na jaai ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, love does not well up, and the filth of egotism does not depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਹੰ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: soha(n) aap pachhaaneeai sabad bhed pateeaai ||
lines.translation: One who recognizes within himself that, "He is me", and who is pierced through by the Shabad, is satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਅਵਰ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh aap pachhaaneeai avar k kare karaai ||9||
lines.translation: When one becomes Gurmukh and realizes his own self, what more is there left to do or have done? ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਲੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: miliaa kaa kiaa meleeai sabad mile pateeaai ||
lines.translation: Why speak of union to those who are already united with the Lord? Receiving the Shabad, they are satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਵੀਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh sojhee naa pavai veechhuR chotaa khaai ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not understand; separated from Him, they endure beatings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dar ghar ek hai avar na doojee jaai ||10||11||
lines.translation: O Nanak, there is only the one door to His Home; there is no other place at all. ||10||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੁਲੈ ਭੁਲਾਈਐ ਭੂਲੀ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh bhulai bhulaaeeai bhoolee thaur na kaai ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs wander around, deluded and deceived. They find no place of rest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ਅੰਧੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bin ko na dikhaavaee a(n)dhee aavai jaai ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, no one is shown the Way. Like the blind, they continue coming and going.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਠਗਿਆ ਮੁਠਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: giaan padaarath khoiaa thagiaa muthaa jaai ||1||
lines.translation: Having lost the treasure of spiritual wisdom, they depart, defrauded and plundered. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa maaiaa bharam bhulaai ||
lines.translation: O Baba, Maya deceives with its illusion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਨਾ ਪਿਰ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharam bhulee dohaaganee naa pir a(n)k samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Deceived by doubt, the discarded bride is not received into the Lap of her Beloved. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਿਸੰਤਰੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhoolee phirai disa(n)taree bhoolee grihu taj jaai ||
lines.translation: The deceived bride wanders around in foreign lands; she leaves, and abandons her own home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੀ ਡੂੰਗਰਿ ਥਲਿ ਚੜੈ ਭਰਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhoolee doo(n)gar thal chaRai bharamai man dolaai ||
lines.translation: Deceived, she climbs the plateaus and mountains; her mind wavers in doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਗਰਬਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dhurahu vichhu(n)nee kiu milai garab muthee bilalaai ||2||
lines.translation: Separated from the Primal Being, how can she meet with Him again? Plundered by pride, she cries out and bewails. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: vichhuRiaa gur melasee har ras naam piaar ||
lines.translation: The Guru unites the separated ones with the Lord again, through the love of the Delicious Name of the Lord.
